speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To help me understand your condition, please tell me: Are you having trouble breathing, and do you notice any grunting or flaring of your nostrils? Also, what was the result of your birth, such as if there were any complications during delivery?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS) secondary to prematurity. Given the infant's gestational age of 33 weeks and the onset of distress within two hours of birth, I suspect surfactant deficiency. I will proceed with a Chest_X-Ray to confirm the characteristic ground-glass appearance and look for air bronchograms.
